def fit(cols,names):
    X=np.column_stack(cols)

    r=dP_dt-X@c
    return np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt), dict(zip(names,np.round(c,4)))

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):

    return (p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*s+p[4]*l

            + p[8]*t*P+p[9]*t*s)

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
